SUMMARY: hairstyle two thick braids gathered into a low tail with a center part; costume silhouette several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth; design idea A single load-bearing spine anchors the rigid cape plates, an engineering motif for her undivided loyalty.; face warm beige skin and pale lilac eyes; expression proudly composed
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Zhang Ren of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the loyal general of Yi — 'a loyal subject does not serve two masters'.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a stoic, unreadable reserve; warm beige skin; heart-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; pale lilac eyes; a thin faint scar through one eyebrow.
Body and hair: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist build; two thick braids gathered into a low tail with a center part; black hair fading to crimson at the tips.
Expression: a proud, poised look with a faint closed-lip smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: unbending loyalty, the ambush at the Fallen Phoenix Slope.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: A single load-bearing spine anchors the rigid cape plates, an engineering motif for her undivided loyalty.
Colours: deep forest green, bronze, ochre and cream. Faction frame: deep forest-green and bronze plating with ochre trim, sturdy mountain-fortress silhouette, cliff-terrace motifs, amber glow lines.
Signature item: a long spear, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: Her left hand steadies the long spear and her right hand hangs open clear of the armor.
Setting detail: A highland landing platform flanked by bronze-green gantry columns.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
